title: main branch is NOT protected — no required status checks enforce 'green before merge'
rootCause: GET repos/.../branches/main/protection → 404 'Branch not protected'. Anyone (or any automation) can merge to main with red/absent checks; main auto-builds+deploys to staging + V2 (build-and-stage / build-and-stage-v2), so an ungated bad merge ships to deliverit-test-v2 with no gate.
suggestedFix: Enable branch protection on main requiring the gating checks (build-and-stage-v2, Backend fast checks, Frontend quality, architecture, Schema drift) + at least 1 review. Keeps the established green-before-merge discipline enforced, not optional.

title: 14 radiator-scorers band-boundary unit tests fail on main HEAD (test vs code boundary semantics)
rootCause: radiator-scorers.spec.ts asserts inclusive boundaries (overallScoreToBand(25)=CRITICAL, (50)=RED, (75)=AMBER; scoreToBand(3)=AMBER), but radiator-scorers.ts uses strict '<' (boundary → better band) and the doc comment matches the code ('score < 1.0 → CRITICAL'). So the TEST contradicts the documented+implemented semantics. Fails on pristine b70f0aae (not introduced by any QA fix).
impact: main's local unit suite is red. Either CI's 'Backend fast' job is also red (and unprotected-main lets merges through) or it excludes these tests (coverage gap). Low USER impact (only exact-boundary scores 25.0/50.0/75.0 differ RED↔CRITICAL etc.).
suggestedFix: Decide the boundary semantics: if strict-< is intended (code+doc), fix the 14 test assertions; if a score exactly at the cutoff should be the WORSE band (conservative risk), change cutoffs to '<=' in scoreToBand/overallScoreToBand and update the doc. Then confirm CI 'Backend fast' actually runs this spec.
evidence: radiator-scorers.ts:152-171 (strict '<' + doc); radiator-scorers.spec.ts:170-176 (inclusive expectations); local jest: 14 failed / 86 passed on pristine main.
